name: BudgetPhasingEditor
tagline: The Budget Phasing Editor lets you split an approved budget across the months of a project, purchase, grant or programme - right on the record.
description: The Budget Phasing Editor lets you split an approved budget across the months of a project, purchase, grant or programme - right on the record. Each budget line (for example labour, licences, hardware, travel and contingency) gets a row, each month gets a column, and the control keeps the totals, the variance against the target budget and a cumulative picture up to date while you type.
features: Budget lines x periods grid with row/column totals
Spread tools (even, front-load, back-load, S-curve, copy)
Target budget variance with tolerance, quarter roll-up
Cumulative chart and a phone card layout
